# Afrishore

> Afrishore — Local Solutions for Global Clients. Integrated marine logistics agency operating across South Africa, Namibia, and Mozambique since 2010. ISO 9001 certified. Direct contracts with TotalEnergies, Odfjell Drilling, Northern Ocean Ltd, Island Drilling, Baker Hughes, Halliburton, Expro, Tidewater, Bourbon, Solstad, Eco Atlantic Oil & Gas, Vantris Energy, SBM Offshore, Fugro, Oceaneering, LD TravOcean, Peschaud, United Offshore Support, Piriou Naval Services and the Port of Réunion. Operations have supported the E&P, telecommunications, renewables and aviation sectors.

## What Afrishore does

Four integrated service verticals supporting offshore oil and gas, subsea engineering, telecoms infrastructure, heavy lift and maritime operations.

### Vessel & Rig Agency

Systemic port agency services for rigs, drillships, OSVs, PSVs, passenger liners, tankers and FPSOs across all South African and Namibian ports. Port clearance, berth scheduling, immigration, dry docking and repairs, procurement and technical support, husbandry, crew rotation, medivac coordination, bunkering arrangements, Off Port Limits (OPL) logistics.

### Offshore Supply Base Operations

Turnkey base operator services for onshore and offshore projects: rigging, cranage, abnormal trucking, warehousing, project cargo handling, waste management, materials management and reporting. Permanently embedded inside the Port of Walvis Bay's Oil & Gas Section.

### Integrated Logistics

Freight forwarding, customs brokerage, port clearance, project cargo, materials management, bunkering, chandling, technical procurement, provisions supply, technical support. Cross-border freight on sea and air for oil and gas, subsea, telecoms, renewables, aviation and heavy lift sectors.

### Crew & Visa Services

Crew rotations, medivacs, visa and immigration optimisation across South Africa, Namibia and Mozambique for offshore and onshore personnel and third-party technicians. Flight coordination, accommodation, transport, medical evacuation coordination.
